`ShapeIndex` serialization via [`Encode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L798) and [`Decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L879) has been implemented on the new branch `shapeindex-serialization` and committed.

### Summary of Changes

1. **`ShapeIndex` Serialization & Deserialization**:
   - Added [`Encode(io.Writer) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L798) and [`Decode(io.Reader) error`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L879) to [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go).
   - Even an empty index encodes to a valid non-empty byte stream containing header metadata.
   - Encodes any pending updates automatically (`maybeApplyUpdates()`) so indexes encoded without explicit `Build()` decode completely.
   - Shape IDs are preserved so cell references remain valid across removals and non-contiguous ID assignments.
   - The spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, `ShapeIndexCell`, `clippedShape`) is completely preserved and marked fresh, allowing immediate queries (`ContainsPointQuery`, `CrossingEdgeQuery`, `ClosestEdgeQuery`, `ShapeIndexRegion`) and iterators to run without calling `Build()`.
   - Decoding guards against malformed input, truncated data, corrupted headers/semantics, and oversized allocation requests without panicking.

2. **Built-in Shape Type Support**:
   - Implemented `Encode` and `Decode` on all built-in types: [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/point_vector.go#L50), [`Polyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/polyline.go#L373), [`Polygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/polygon.go#L1022), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/lax_polyline.go#L67), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/lax_polygon.go#L229), [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/loop.go#L1259), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/lax_loop.go#L93).
   - Added type tags for [`Loop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shape.go#L153) and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shape.go#L154).
   - Ensured zero-edge shapes (empty/full loops, empty polylines/polygons/points) and multi-chain shapes round-trip accurately without coordinate distortion.

3. **Incremental Updates & Index Stability**:
   - Implemented [`tracker.lowerBound`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L540) to support incremental shape index updates.
   - Fixed iterator calls in [`shrinkToFit`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L977) and [`updateEdges`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L1031) to prevent recursive mutex lockups during post-decode mutations.
   - Added [`removeShapeInternal`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex.go#L1539) to cleanly prune removed shape references from index cells.

4. **Testing**:
   - Added comprehensive tests in [`s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-ia3yhpp7/s2/shapeindex_encode_test.go) covering empty indexes, all built-in shapes, ID survival across removals, spatial queries without `Build`, zero-edge/mixed chain configurations, subsequent index modifications after decode, and fuzz testing for malformed and oversized byte inputs.
   - All package tests (`go test ./...`) pass cleanly with race detection enabled.
